title: The Slow Garden Anew
author: Theo Nystrom
blurb: Isandro Fairweather, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
